ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Acutaas Chemicals reported exceptionally strong Q2 FY27 financial results, driven by robust performance in its Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediate (CDMO) segment, which prompted an upward revision of FY27 revenue and EBITDA margin guidance. The company notably accelerated its CDMO revenue target to INR 1,000 crores by FY27 and aims for INR 2,000 crores by FY30, indicating strong future growth and material impact. While the Specialty Chemicals segment was temporarily muted, new Battery and Semiconductor chemical ventures are showing promising initial commercialization, with the only notable watch point being an increase in working capital due to higher debtor days.
